map.title: Interactive Heritage Map
map.description: Explore India's diverse states and union territories. Click on different regions to discover their unique cultural heritage!
map.heritageDesc: Each state and union territory has its own unique cultural heritage, festivals, art forms, and monuments.
map.northernStates: Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana, Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Delhi
map.westernStates: Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Dadra & Nagar Haveli, Daman & Diu
map.easternStates: West Bengal, Odisha, Jharkhand, Bihar, Sikkim
map.southernStates: Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Puducherry, Lakshadweep
map.discoverDesc: From the snow-capped mountains of the north to the tropical beaches of the south, explore the rich cultural diversity of India through our interactive features.

stories.title: AI-Powered Heritage Stories
stories.subtitle: Heritage Stories
stories.description: Immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of Indian history through our AI-enhanced storytelling experience. Listen to ancient tales, legends, and historical accounts brought to life.
stories.enhancedDesc: Our AI-powered platform brings history to life with immersive audio, interactive elements, and personalized experiences.
stories.aiNarrationDesc: Natural voice synthesis with regional accents and emotional expression
stories.immersiveAudioDesc: 3D spatial audio with ambient sounds and music from the era
stories.interactiveDesc: Click to explore artifacts, view historical images, and access additional context
stories.aiGuideDesc: Get instant answers about Indian culture, festivals, monuments, and history. Our AI guide speaks both English and Hindi!
stories.welcomeHindi: हेरिटेज AI में आपका स्वागत है!
stories.askAbout: Ask me about Indian festivals, monuments, or any cultural topic!
stories.askAboutHindi: मुझसे भारतीय त्योहारों, स्मारकों या किसी भी सांस्कृतिक विषय के बारे में पूछें!
stories.askPlaceholderHindi: भारतीय विरासत के बारे में पूछें...
stories.aiCompanion: Your virtual companion for exploring Indian culture
stories.aiCompanionHindi: भारतीय संस्कृति की खोज के लिए आपका आभासी साथी

games.title: Cultural Mini-Games
games.subtitle: Mini-Games
games.description: Learn about Indian heritage through fun interactive games. Match attire, solve puzzles, and test your knowledge to earn badges and rewards!
games.puzzleComplete: You completed the Taj Mahal Puzzle!
games.monumentDesc: You've mastered the art of reconstructing architectural wonders!
games.instructions: Click on tiles adjacent to the empty space to slide them. Use the reference image to reconstruct the Taj Mahal.
games.movableHint: Movable tiles are highlighted in saffron • Match the reference image
games.question: Question
games.badgesDesc: Earn special badges by completing games and mastering Indian heritage knowledge.

ar.title: Augmented Reality Try-On Experience
ar.subtitle: Try-On Experience
ar.description: Step into the world of Indian heritage with our cutting-edge AR technology. Try on traditional attire, explore ancient artifacts, and experience history like never before.
ar.arCameraDesc: Try on traditional Indian cultural elements using your webcam
ar.readyToTry: Ready to try on in AR
ar.chooseSidebar: Choose from the sidebar to start your AR experience
ar.tipText: Position your face in the red detection box for best results!
ar.advancedDesc: Experience heritage like never before with our cutting-edge augmented reality features.
ar.realTimeDesc: Advanced computer vision for precise object placement and tracking
ar.interactionDesc: Touch, rotate, and scale 3D objects with intuitive gestures
ar.educationalDesc: Learn about historical context and cultural significance
ar.arMemoriesDesc: Capture and save your cultural try-on experiences
